dict.string: Home uses the camera to photograph a beer, coffee, walk or pub as you log it. Photos you capture are uploaded to your own site and are used nowhere else.

Home reads your daily step count and walking distance so the site's homepage can show a live activity signal. Only the daily totals leave this phone — no workouts, no heart rate, no location, and nothing that identifies you.
Home lets you attach a photo you have already taken to a fun entry or a project. It reads only the images you pick.
